messages:
elaine: Rolling routing-v2 canary -> 30% in EU (staged). Starting post-deploy smoke and synthetic probes now. Will monitor route fanout, KV warmup, and embed path.

qa-bot: [synth] eu-west1 synth-run #1788 started. checkers: p50/p95/5xx. Expected baseline: p95 ~100ms, 5xx <0.1%.

deploy-bot: [deploy] routing-v2 canary=30% in eu-west1 at 2026-03-23T14:02Z. Metrics stream: /deploys/1788888888.

raj: Noticing p95 drift in the synth after ~2m: p95 ~420ms, p50 ~120ms, 5xx 0.2%. Traces point to additional backend fanout and KV misses. sample trace: trace=def456.

elaine: Quick health dump from one host:
```
GET /_health -> {"ok":false,"services":{"kv_prefill":{"miss_rate":0.18},"embed_shim":{"errors":0.01}},"latency_ms":420}
```

raj: That miss_rate is ~6x baseline. Might be prefill TTL or a change in prefill key format in routing-v2. If prefill misses spike, downstream fanout retries increase tail.

opsbot: Dry-run pin suggestion: eu-west1 30% -> routing-v1 (dry). Approve with `/ops pin promote 1788888888 eu-west1` to apply.

elaine: I want to avoid customer-visible tail; I'm +1 for immediate pin to v1 for EU and pausing global rollout. @raj can you confirm quick rollback plan?

raj: Confirmed. Plan: promote dry-pin to 100% in EU, pause rollouts elsewhere, create INF-999 (investigate prefill key/TTL), attach traces.

deploy-bot: Action queued. To execute rollback run `/deploy rollback 1788888888 --region eu-west1 --target routing-v1`.

elaine: Executing rollback now. :wrench:

deploy-bot: Rollback started at 1788888920. Promoting traffic to routing-v1 in eu-west1 to 100%. Canary paused globally. Hooks: traffic-surgeon + alerting.

qa-bot: Post-rollback synth snapshot (T+60s): p95 ~95ms, 5xx back to 0.04%, kv_prefill miss_rate 0.02.

raj: Good rollback signal. Creating INF-999 for root cause: suspected key-format change in routing-v2 and missing migration. Tagging eng-runtime and eng-ml.

elaine: Updating release notes and CHANGELOG: note staged rollback for routing-v2 in EU due to KV prefill regression; user impact: transient tail-latency for a subset of requests. Will mark routing-v2 as blocked for global rollout until INF-999 resolved.

opsbot: Pin promoted: eu-west1 -> routing-v1 at 1788888939. Dry-run promoted to active.

elaine: Follow-ups: 1) INF-999 triage + reproduce locally in staging 2) Add KV prefill check to canary smoke checklist (pre-warm sample keys and assert miss_rate <0.05) 3) Re-run canary after fix with smaller ramp.

raj: I'll own INF-999. Will post short playbook with steps to validate prefill migration.

elaine: Closing thread. Thanks all for quick move. We'll reopen rollout thread once fix + verification complete. :white_check_mark:
